OUTCOME.statement: Configure only the entrance porch so the left and right columns land on the specified tread counts while preserving the openings, footprint, and roof.

provenance.quote: Entrance porch only. Left column lands on 3 treads. Right column lands on 5. Approximate level offset: 34–36 cm. Openings / footprint / roof: unchanged.

EXPLICIT.statement: Limit the work to the entrance porch.
Configure the left column to land on three treads.
Configure the right column to land on five treads.
Use an approximate level offset of 34–36 cm.
Keep the openings, footprint, and roof unchanged.

INFERRED.statement: Changes outside the entrance porch are outside the requested scope.
The 34–36 cm offset is a working approximation rather than an exact surveyed value.

LOCKED.statement: Elements outside the entrance porch are locked against change.
The footprint is locked against change.
The roof is locked against change.

UNKNOWN.statement: The exact surveyed level is unavailable.

AUTHORIZED.statement: Configuring the porch column-to-tread relationships within the approximate level offset is authorized.

provenance.quote: Left column lands on 3 treads. Right column lands on 5. Approximate level offset: 34–36 cm.

NOT_AUTHORIZED.statement: Changes outside the entrance porch are not authorized.
Changes to openings, the footprint, or the roof are not authorized.
Inventing an exact surveyed level is not authorized.

ACCEPTANCE.statement: The left column lands on three treads and the right column lands on five.
